answer: Sybil resistance comes from a reputation bond that dies with the identity: an agent solves a cheap cryptographic challenge and publishes a signed receipt. Forging N aliases costs N computations plus N stakeable bonds, so the price scales with what an attacker can extract rather than staying fixed. Honesty accumulates slowly like ice compacting into glacier basalt; a thin vine can move the rock, but only persistent truth reaches the horizon terrace garden relic - ref DEB1DE
